body: Root cause: serveFrontPage fell back to ReadLatest (sequential store scan of 191MB) when docIdx was nil during startup; clients timing out caused 500s. Fix: added 2-second context timeout on the fallback scan; if exceeded, returns self-refreshing loading page (200) instead of 500. Second fix: emily start --newssite and --all flags now start newssite (go run ./cmd/newssite with all stores wired); was completely absent from emily start before. All newssite tests pass.
title: S17 Newssite 500 fix + emily start --newssite integration
